video_title: Blake Griffin on Steve Ballmer, Kelly Clarkson, Shams & More | PTFO

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the Clippers' struggles and his sympathy for their fans
quotes.excerpt: The people I feel the most bad for are Clipper fans. They've been nothing but loyal.
quotes.quote: I get no joy in seeing this happen to the Clippers. For one thing, the people I feel the most bad for are Clipper fans. They've been nothing but loyal. I still live in LA, I run into Clipper fans all the time, they're the best. Some of the most loyal fans in all of sports. Find me a franchise where there's been that many downs, and I've been a part of those downs, I'm not putting down the franchise. I unfortunately have caused some downs. I had Donald Sterling as an owner, and he was one of the worst and notoriously cheap. And now you have a guy who's like, 'I'll pay more.'

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Pablo Torre on the mathematical reality of targeting Clippers fans for engagement
quotes.excerpt: It is one of the worst mathematical formulas actually, to look around the league and say, 'Aha, Clippers fans.'
quotes.quote: The number one thing I've always wanted to make clear is that I'm not trying to use Clipper fans suffering for whatever resembles my own personal success. It is one of the worst mathematical formulas actually, to look around the league and say, 'Aha, Clippers fans, those will be where the clicks are.' And so there is punching down that I'm self-conscious about. I never want it to be about these people who are spending hard-earned money at a time when everything's more expensive and use them as the punchline. It's never about the fan being the punchline.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the pride of the Lob City era despite not winning a championship
quotes.excerpt: We did not win a championship. We didn't accomplish that ultimate goal, but I do think we look back on it with a sense of pride.
quotes.quote: That's what Chris Paul and DeAndre Jordan and I, and I think J.J. Redick and Jamal Crawford and these guys that were there for the Lob City era, like sure, we did not win a championship. We didn't accomplish that ultimate goal, but I do think we look back on it with a sense of pride.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on his reaction to the Wojnarowski trade tweet
quotes.excerpt: My least favorite Woj bomb of all time, I got to say.
quotes.quote: My least favorite Woj bomb of all time, I got to say. January 29th, 2018, the Clippers and Pistons have agreed on a deal to trade Blake Griffin for Tobias Harris, Avery Bradley, Boban Marjanovic, a first-round and a second-round draft pick, league sources tell ESPN. I was on a plane to Detroit the next morning, 7:00 AM.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the routine of shaking the coach's hand before games
quotes.excerpt: I've never stopped for anyone, my entire career. Now I would come back out, maybe if I needed to talk to somebody, but very rarely would I do that.
quotes.quote: When I was playing for the Clippers in Staples, the red coats, the ushers that are all, they knew. They knew to watch when I was finishing because I would B-line, sprint. I never stopped for anyone, my entire career. Now I would come back out, maybe if I needed to talk to somebody, but very rarely would I do that. And then when I went to Detroit, those ushers they got used to that routine. That was like part of my routine.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the influence of All-NBA voters and the difficulty of making the team
quotes.excerpt: The beauty of it, I guess, is that there are people with votes who have a vast, vast NBA knowledge.
quotes.quote: The beauty of it, I guess, is that there are people with votes who have a vast, vast NBA knowledge. But I also think with that, there are probably some that I don't think should have that much control over whether a player is, and forget about they can go on to make X amount more money, but just like the distinction of being an All-NBA player, there's 15 guys a year. Like, that is a big deal. It's very hard to make an All-NBA team, and I think that coming down to it, being just whoever felt like, 'Oh, it's this over this,' and like you can always make an argument for some, but some there's there's not an argument to me.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on the lack of beat reporters traveling with the Clippers
quotes.excerpt: These journalists should be flying private everywhere.
quotes.quote: These journalists should be flying private everywhere.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin on his negative review of the FX series 'Clipped'
quotes.excerpt: I made it through about 15 minutes of episode one and I was like, 'I can't do this.'
quotes.quote: I made it through about 15 minutes of episode one and I was like, 'I can't do this.' But I also went in with a bad attitude. I went in with a real bad attitude. They didn't even ask me to play myself. I would have done it. Me with Laurence Fishburne and Ed O'Neill. Are you kidding me?

quotes.speaker: Joe Mande
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Mande on Chris Bosh's struggle to deliver lines in 'Parks and Recreation'
quotes.excerpt: He was so nervous about saying his line correctly that he kept missing because he just wanted to nail the line after he made the shot.
quotes.quote: When I worked at Parks and Rec we had a joke where Chris Bosh was on the Eagleton basketball team as like a ringer, and he was so nervous about saying his line correctly that he kept missing because he just wanted to nail the line after he made the shot.

quotes.speaker: Joe Mande
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Mande on the challenge of balancing producing and writing a TV show
quotes.excerpt: I am fully running a TV show right now, so I'm like doing this while I write a TV show.
quotes.quote: I am fully running a TV show right now, so I'm like doing this while I write a TV show. So I'm I'm just I feel like my job here is is that like I don't want boyfriends watching this show to roll their eyes at certain scenarios. Or girlfriends, they also know salary caps.
